citations.excerpt: This council was called in May, 381, by Emperor Theodosius , to provide for a Catholic succession in the patriarchal See of Constantinople , to confirm the Nicene Faith, to reconcile the semi-Arians with the Church , and to put an end to the Macedonian heresy .

facts.value: Council called by Theodosius that confirmed the Nicene faith.
